modelNotes: Minutes Engine 1.1 uses player-pool status plus season, last 5, and last 10 minutes from NBA history.
Unknown starters retain their historical minutes baseline and are not treated as confirmed bench players.
Missing injury information does not mean a player is cleared; publication eligibility requires confirmed game status and role.
Roles are Core Starter, Starter, Rotation, Bench, Deep Bench, and Inactive.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.detail: With Caruso already ruled out for Wednesday's game in Dallas due to an ankle sprain, it sounds like the veteran forward could remain sidelined beyond a one-game absence. That would leave Oklahoma City without one of its key rotation wings for at least the near term, which could force Jared McCain into a big role for the banged-up Thunder.

injury.shortComment: Sarr (knee) is out for Monday's game against Orlando.
injury.detail: Sarr was previously listed as questionable after picking up the knock Friday against the Hornets. With Sarr out of commission, the Wizards could lean more on backup center Deandre Ayton and may slide him into the first unit.

injury.shortComment: Diallo (wrist) is listed as questionable for Monday's game versus Portland.
injury.detail: Diallo made his only appearance of the 2026-27 campaign in the 96-84 Opening Night loss to Oklahoma City. Since then, he has missed the Nuggets' last four games. While the personal issue that contributed to his absence has seemingly been resolved, a right wrist sprain may keep him off the floor for the fifth time this season.

players.statusSource: ESPN team roster; game availability not confirmed

injury.shortComment: Nembhard (cervical strain) is out for Monday's game against Atlanta.
injury.detail: The Pacers are going to sit multiple key players for the second leg of this back-to-back set. With Nembhard sidelined, Quenton Jackson could be set up for an extended workload.

injury.shortComment: Black will be rested Monday against the Wizards.
injury.detail: The Magic are listing him out for left ankle injury management, so they are taking a cautious approach for the second leg of this back-to-back set. He finished with 23 points (6-12 FG, 1-5 3Pt, 10-11 FT), eight rebounds, three assists and two steals over 33 minutes Sunday against Boston. Jase Richardson, Jevon Carter and Jamal Cain could be more involved as a result.

players.statusSource: ESPN team roster; game availability not confirmed

injury.shortComment: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.
injury.detail: Edwards underwent debridement surgery in Minnesota, though the team did not provide a timetable for his return. The star guard is expected to make a full recovery, with additional updates coming as he progresses through rehabilitation. Based on previous reporting from ESPN's Shams Charania, Edwards could miss up to two months. Edwards was off to a scorching start this season, averaging 33.3 points, 4.8 rebounds, 3.5 assists and 2.0 steals across four appearances.

players.statusSource: ESPN team roster; game availability not confirmed

injury.shortComment: Gill (back) is out for Monday's game against the Magic.
injury.detail: Gill was unable to shake his questionable tag for this contest. His absence is not expected to make any waves in the rotation.

injury.shortComment: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.
injury.detail: Sheppard required a full repair and is without a definitive timetable for a return to action. With Tyrese Haliburton (hamstring) expected to miss at least two weeks, Quenton Jackson figures to see a significant uptick in playing time. Two-way player Braden Smith could also see increased action with the parent club.

players.statusSource: ESPN team roster; game availability not confirmed

injury.shortComment: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.
injury.detail: Wallace is expected to miss most, if not all, of the season. However, there's still a chance he will return late in the campaign after sustaining the shoulder injury in Sunday's win over the Clippers. With Jalen Williams (leg) also set to be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Alex Caruso (ankle) should see significant playing time once cleared to return. In the meantime, Jared McCain, Bennett Stirtz and Josh Dix are expected to see increased burn.

injury.shortComment: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.
injury.detail: This is another massive blow to an Oklahoma City squad that's already set to be without Jalen Williams (leg) and Cason Wallace (shoulder) for most, if not all, of the season. With Holmgren sidelined, Kenrich Williams, Jaylin Williams and Aday Mara are all candidates to see increased playing time. Two-way player Brooks Barnhizer could also see more minutes.

injury.detail: Capela has been downgraded from questionable to out and will miss his second game of the season. With Steven Adams (knee) also sidelined, Oscar Tshiebwe could enter the rotation behind Alperen Sengun.

injury.detail: Jones exited Sunday's loss to the Warriors and did not return due to a right knee injury. He's now listed on the injury report with right knee soreness, and the veteran forward's next chance to play will come Wednesday against Miami. In the meantime, Kobe Sanders, Baba Miller and Gradey Dick are candidates for increased playing time.

The move provides additional long-term stability but doesn't directly impact his immediate fantasy outlook. injury.detail: Niederhauser remains unlikely to play a meaningful role in the short term following a seven-month recovery from foot surgery.
